blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is moving from the harness of prompts and tools around a base model toward the model itself. However, existing RSI still faces key challenges, including harness-bound gains that stay outside the base model, black-box supervision that reads only the model's outputs, and imprecise edits whose site and strength are fixed in advance. To address these challenges, we propose BaseRSI, a new paradigm of Recursive Harness Internalization: the base model improves its harness, then writes what the harness adds into its own weights through training-free edits, round after round on its own responses. To support this paradigm, we introduce ReGap, a mechanism that supervises every transformer block with the high-dimensional activation difference that the harness makes at that block alone, and updates the block's weights along this signal in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this mechanism, we further propose ReKey, an algorithm that writes this signal by regression into a few key-value neurons of every block, and measures the site and strength of each edit on the model's own responses. Moreover, the base model fills every role of this recursion with forward passes alone, and its edits, written at different sites, compose in one checkpoint without refitting. Experimental results on ten visual reasoning benchmarks show that BaseRSI consistently improves a base vision-language model both in distribution and on held-out benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/BaseRSI.
blocks.zh: 递进式自我改进(RSI)正在从一个基建模型周围的提示和工具的利用转向模型本身. 然而,现有的区域信息系统仍然面临重大挑战,包括不受基准模式约束的利用收益、只读模型产出的黑箱监督、以及网站和实力事先固定的不准确编辑。 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议BaseRSI, 内化循环的新范式: 基础模型改进了它的驾驭, 然后通过免费的编辑, 逐个回转, 写下它给自己的重量。 为了支持这个范式,我们引入了ReGap这个机制,这个机制可以监督每个变压器块, 上面有高维的激活差值, 光是在那个块上, 并且用一个低维的子空间来更新这个块的重量。 基于这个机制,我们进一步提出ReKey,这个算法通过回归将这个信号写成每个区块的几个关键值神经元,并在模型自己的响应中测量每个编辑的站点和强度. 此外,基数模式仅用前方通行证填补了这种重复的每一个角色,其编辑则在不同的站点写成,在一个检查站编成,而不复发。 关于10个视觉推理基准的实验结果显示,BaseRSI在分发和搁置基准上都不断改进一个基本视觉语言模型。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/beita6969/BaseRSI上查阅。

blocks.en: In recent years, a variety of recursive self-improvement (RSI) systems have let foundation models improve the prompts, tools, and context they work with [ 32 , 31 , 82 ] , gradually moving from the harness around a frozen model toward improving the base model itself.
blocks.zh: 近年来,各种递归自我改进(RSI)系统让基础模型改进了它们与[32,31,82]合作的提示,工具和背景,逐渐从被冻结的模型左右转向改进基础模型本身.

blocks.en:
In this process, the harness has become a key bridge from a frozen base model to a stronger system: by adding verified procedures and finer views to the request, a vision-language model can answer visual questions with improved accuracy, controllability, and reuse (Figure 1 ).
However, in practice, these gains still live in the request rather than in the model [ 60 , 75 ] , making them costly on every request and leaving the base model unable to build on what its harness learns.
blocks.zh:
在这个过程中,牵引已经成为一个从被冻结的基站模型到更强大的系统的关键桥梁:通过在请求中添加经核实的程序和更细化的观点,一个视觉语言模型能够以更好的准确性,可控性和再利用性来回答视觉问题(图1).
然而,在实践中,这些收益仍然停留在请求中,而不是模型[60,75]中,这使得每次请求都要付出高昂的代价,使得基础模型无法在它所学到的知识上更上一层楼。

blocks.en:
Along this path from the harness to the model, three main lines of work have emerged, as shown in Figure 2 .
First, harness evolution rewrites the prompts, tools, and programs around frozen weights [ 32 , 31 , 68 , 70 ] , treating the harness as the object of self-improvement.
Second, model–harness co-evolution updates the weights together with the harness through fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or distillation [ 76 , 38 , 18 ] , moving harness gains into the model.
Third, weight editing writes new behavior into the weights directly, as memories of facts and mistakes [ 44 , 45 , 26 ] or as updates computed directly from forward passes [ 46 , 72 ] .

blocks.en: However, these methods still face three challenges (Figure 2 a–c). (i) Harness-bound gains. Harness evolution improves what surrounds a frozen model [ 32 , 31 , 68 ] ; every addition costs context again on each request and is lost when the harness is taken away [ 60 , 75 , 18 ] , so the gains accumulate outside the base model and its own capability stays where it started. (ii) Black-box supervision. Co-evolution and harness distillation supervise the weights only at the output of the model, with trajectories, rewards, or output distributions [ 75 , 58 , 38 , 81 ] ; what the harness changes inside the model stays hidden, so the signal travels back through every block by gradient training, which is slow and internalizes noise [ 18 ] . (iii) Imprecise edits. Weight editing sets the site and strength of an edit by a preset rule, in a few layers [ 45 ] or the last layer [ 26 ] ; localization does not tell where an edit works best [ 23 , 48 ] , so edits miss part of their target [ 6 ] and harm general abilities [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,这些方法仍然面临三个挑战(图2a-c)。 (一) 利用约束性收益。 利用性进化可以改善被冻结的模型的周围环境[32,31,68];每次请求时,每次增加成本的情况都会再次出现,当被带走[60,75,18]时就会丢失,因此收益会累积在基模型之外,而且其自身的能力会停留在它开始的地方. (二)黑箱监管. 共同演化和取用蒸馏只监督模型输出时的权重,有轨迹,奖赏,或输出分布[75,58,38,81];模型内部的取用变化如何会保持隐藏,因此信号会以梯度训练回行于每个区块,它缓慢地并内化了噪声[18]. (三)Imprecise编辑. 重量编辑将编辑的站点和强度按预设规则设置,分几层[45]或最后一层[26];本地化并不能说明编辑在什么地方效果最好[23,48],因此编辑会错过部分目标[6]并损害一般能力[21].

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose BaseRSI (Figure 2 d), a new paradigm of Recursive Harness Internalization that runs in two loops: in the outer loop, the base model adds candidate entries to its harness, and an acceptance test keeps those whose gain generalizes.
In the inner loop, the base model with an accepted entry in the request is the teacher, the same model on the original request is the student, and the teacher and the unedited student first answer the development questions.
To support this paradigm, we introduce ReGap , a mechanism that replays each response through the teacher and the student, takes the difference that the entry makes at every block alone, the teacher–student gap, as a high-dimensional target inside the model rather than at its output, and turns each gap into a low-dimensional update of that block’s weights.
Building on this mechanism, we further propose ReKey , an algorithm that first measures on the student’s responses which weights the entry should be written into, then writes the gaps by regression into a few key–value neurons of every block, and finally measures the strength of the edit on held-out responses.
The edited student then answers again, and since the edit has changed its responses, the next round repeats these steps on the new ones. After the last round, the edits written at different sites add up in one checkpoint, which answers the original requests alone.
Throughout, the base model fills every role with its own forward passes, and BaseRSI joins harness evolution, weight editing, and internalization into one recursive loop that makes the base model itself stronger.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们提议BaseRSI(图2d),一个循环性Harness内化(Recursive Harness Internalization)的新范式,它分为两个循环:在外循环中,基础模型在它的驾驭上增加了候选条目,一个验收测试保留了那些收益被概括的人.
在"内环"中,请求中包含一个被接受条目的基模为"老师",原请求中的同名模型为"学生",由老师和未经编辑的学生首先回答发展的问题.
为了支持这个范式,我们引入了ReGap,这个通过师生重放每个响应的机制,将条目在每一个街区(师生差距)带来的差异作为模型内部的高维度目标,而不是其输出,并将每个缺口转化为该街区重量的低维更新.
基于这个机制,我们进一步提出ReKey,这个算法首先衡量学生的回答,然后将输入的分量通过回归来写入每个区块的几个关键-价值神经元,最后用被搁置的回答来衡量编辑的强度。
被编辑的学生随后再次回答,由于被编辑更改了答复,下一轮在新步骤上重复这些步骤. 上一轮过后,不同站点所写的编辑内容加在一起一个检查点,只回答原始请求.
在整个过程中,基站模型以自己的前行传入来来填补每个角色,而BaseRSI加入到拉带进化,重量编辑,内部化中,成为了使基站模型本身更坚固的循环.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on five in-distribution and five held-out visual reasoning benchmarks across perception, counting, charts, spatial reasoning, and visual logic.
Results show that BaseRSI outperforms prompting, visual zoom-in, harness evolution, and fine-tuning on every benchmark and carries over to other base models (RQ1, RQ2), that the edited checkpoint exceeds its own harness in the request while answering original requests on standard inference engines (RQ3), and that supervision inside the model and a measured site and strength each add to the gain (RQ4, RQ5).
These results mark a step toward base models that recursively improve their own weights.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了五个分布式和五个被搁置的视觉推理基准,这些基准跨越了认知、计数、图表、空间推理和视觉逻辑。
结果表明,BaseRSI在每一个基准上都超过了促进、视觉放大、利用进化和微调,并结转到其他基准模型(RQ1,RQ2),经过编辑的检查点在请求中超越了自己的利用率,同时在标准推论引擎(RQ3)上答复了原始请求,模型内部的监督以及一个被测量的站点和强度各增加了收益(RQ4,RQ5)。
这些结果标志着向基础模型迈出了一步,这些模型不断提高自身的权重。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Self-Improving Harnesses and Models. Harness evolution searches and rewrites prompts, tools, and programs around frozen weights [ 32 , 31 , 82 , 68 , 70 , 37 ] , and co-evolution, harness distillation, and self-edits also update the weights, by fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or distillation from a teacher that holds the context [ 75 , 76 , 58 , 38 , 69 , 81 , 35 , 28 , 18 , 83 , 8 ] , at times with a scheduler choosing between harness and weights [ 24 , 60 ] .
The former keeps its gains in the request and the latter supervises the weights at the output, and both often run an external frontier model as proposer or corrector [ 32 , 75 , 76 , 24 ] .
BaseRSI keeps every role in one base model and writes each accepted entry into its weights from the gap measured inside the model.
blocks.zh:
自我改进的运用与模式. 利用进化的搜索和重写了被冻结重量的提示、工具和程序[32、31、82、68、70、37],以及共同进化、取用蒸馏和自编自导自导自导自导自导自导[75、76、58、38、69、81、35、28、18、83、8],通过微调、强化学习或从掌握背景的教师那里取出蒸馏法来更新重量[24、60],有时还使用排程器来选择取取用重量和重量[24、60]。
前者保留其在请求中的收益,而后者则监督产出的权重,两者都经常以提议者或修正者的身份运行外部前沿模式[32,75,76,24].
BaseRSI将每个角色都保留在一个基模型中,并将每个被接受的条目从模型内所测出的差距中写入其分量.

blocks.en:
Weight Editing and Parametric Memory. Weight editing writes facts, mistakes, and experiences into one or a few layers, the last layer, or adapters [ 44 , 45 , 26 , 51 , 80 ] , and more precise or neighbor-aware edits raise locality [ 48 , 6 ] , while edits still miss related knowledge and can harm general abilities [ 78 , 12 , 21 ] .
A context or behavior is also condensed into weights, as steering directions [ 5 ] , implicit or least-squares block updates [ 13 , 20 , 42 ] , edits from contrastive forward passes [ 46 , 14 ] , or dormant neurons [ 77 ] , and specialists of one base are fused from forward passes [ 72 ] ; concurrently, a frontier model rewrites the weights of a small model [ 59 ] .
In contrast, BaseRSI fits each edit to the gap of every block alone, measures its site and strength, and refits it round by round on the model’s own responses.
blocks.zh:
重量编辑与参数记忆. 重量编辑将事实,错误,经验写入一层或几层,上层,或适配器[44,45,26,51,80],更精确或相邻的编辑提高地分[48,6],而编辑仍然错过了相关知识,可能损害一般能力[78,12,21].
上下文或行为也被收缩成权重,如方向[5],隐含或最小平方块更新[13,20,42],从对比前传[46,14],或休眠后神经元[77],一个基地的专家由前传[72]接通;同时,边疆模型会重写出一个小模型的权重[59].
对比之下,BaseRSI将每个编辑与每个区块的空隙相匹配,测量它的站点和强度,并在模型自己的响应上逐个调整.

blocks.en:
The paradigm lets the base model keep what its harness learns.
BaseRSI treats the harness as a fast system that records new experience and the weights as a slow system that consolidates it through replay [ 43 , 30 ] , and joins them in one cycle (Figure 3 , top): an outer loop finds a gain in the harness, an inner loop moves it into the weights, and the next cycle looks for a further gain.

blocks.en: ReGap is the mechanism of the inner loop: it states what the teacher teaches in every block, a high-dimensional signal, and in what form the student keeps it, a low-dimensional update of the block’s weights (Figure 3 , bottom left).

High-dimensional signal. The whole effect of an entry on a response is a set of additions, one per block.
We define the gap of block l l by running the block on the teacher’s states with and without the entry in the request, and treat it as an implicit update of the block’s MLP weights [ 13 , 20 , 42 ] : 𝒈 l = F l ​ ( 𝒔 l − 1 c , 𝒛 l − 1 c ) − F l ​ ( 𝒔 l − 1 c , 𝒛 l − 1 ) , \bm{g}_{l}=F_{l}\big(\bm{s}^{c}_{l-1};\,\bm{z}^{c}_{l-1}\big)-F_{l}\big(\bm{s}^{c}_{l-1};\,\bm{z}_{l-1}\big), (6) where F l F_{l} is the block map of Eq. ( 1 ) and the superscript c c marks the states of the teacher.
Both terms take the same response states, so 𝒈 l \bm{g}_{l} is what the entry adds at block l l alone, its direct effect [ 49 ] , and gaps of different blocks share no part.
For a procedure entry, the teacher’s attention layers read procedure tokens that the student’s request lacks, and 𝒈 l \bm{g}_{l} is the part of the block’s output that they account for.

blocks.en: ReKey is the algorithm that computes the update of Eq. ( 7 ) from forward passes alone: it first measures the site of an edit, then writes the gap by regression into a few key–value neurons of every block, and finally measures its strength, all on the model’s own responses (Figure 3 , bottom right).
blocks.zh: ReKey是计算 Eq. (7) 更新的算法, 仅从前行通过: 它首先测量编辑的站点, 然后通过回归来将空白写入每个区块的几个关键值的神经元, 最后测量它的强度, 全部都是在模型自己的响应上(图3, 右下方).

blocks.en:
Site. Before any fit, ReKey measures the site of an edit, the weights that an entry is written into.
It replays the student’s own responses with the outputs of its linear-attention layers set to those of the teacher and measures the fraction of the divergence from the teacher that this patch removes [ 49 ] : η ( c ) = 1 − KL ¯ ( π θ c ∥ π θ lin ← c ) / KL ¯ ( π θ c ∥ π θ ) , \eta(c)=1-\overline{\mathrm{KL}}\big(\pi^{c}_{\theta}\,\big\|\,\pi^{\mathrm{lin}\leftarrow c}_{\theta}\big)\,\big/\,\overline{\mathrm{KL}}\big(\pi^{c}_{\theta}\,\big\|\,\pi_{\theta}\big), (8) where π θ lin ← c \pi^{\mathrm{lin}\leftarrow c}_{\theta} is the patched student.
Linear attention carries the request as a running state, which converts exactly into bias terms [ 10 ] , whereas full attention retrieves single image tokens. A high fraction therefore sends the entry to the MLP neurons, which read the gap from the activations, and a low fraction sends it to the patch embedding, since such an entry changes what the model sees.

blocks.en: We evaluate BaseRSI through the following research questions (RQs). RQ1: How does BaseRSI compare with prompting, visual zoom-in, harness evolution, and fine-tuning in distribution? RQ2: Does its gain generalize to held-out (OOD) benchmarks and to other base models? RQ3: Does the base model alone keep the gain of its harness after internalization, and do rounds on its own responses add to a one-shot edit (Section 4.1 )? RQ4: Does supervision inside the model carry more of this gain into the weights than supervision at its output (Section 4.2 )? RQ5: Do a measured site and strength make the edit more effective than preset ones, and at what cost (Section 4.3 )?

blocks.en:
Setup. Five in-distribution (ID) benchmarks, BabyVision [ 11 ] , BLINK [ 17 ] , CharXiv [ 66 ] , VisuLogic [ 71 ] , and VLMs Are Biased [ 63 ] , supply the development questions; five out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks, ChartQAPro [ 41 ] , HallusionBench [ 22 ] , PerceptionBench [ 34 ] , SpatialViz [ 64 ] , and VisualPuzzles [ 57 ] , are held out from every loop, and each test set has 128 questions on unseen images.
We compare with prompting and sampling, visual zoom-in, harness evolution, and fine-tuning on the same base model, Qwen3.8-27B, and list two closed-source models for reference [ 4 , 47 ] (Table 1 ).
Over eight generations the base model proposes 269 candidates from its own failures, and the accepted entries, a finer view and a counting procedure, are internalized as the view edit and the procedure edit.
We report accuracy over three runs and the restoration of an edit, the fraction of the divergence from the teacher that it removes on held-out responses (Appendix D ).

设相. 五个分配(ID)基准,Baby Vision [11],BLINK [17],CharXiv [66],VisuLogic [71],以及VLMs Are Biased [63],提供发展问题;五个分配(OOD)基准,ChartQAPro [41],Hallusion Bench [22],Perepion Bench [34],SpaceViz [64],和VisualPizzles [57], 在每个测试中都有128个关于隐形图像的问题。
我们比较了提示和取样、视觉放大、利用进化以及同一种基模型Quen3.8-27B上的微调,并列出两个封闭源模型供参考[4、47](表1)。
八代多来,基建模式从自己的失败中提出269名候选人,被接受的条目,更精细的视图和计票程序,随着视图的编辑和程序的编辑被内部化.
校对:Soup

blocks.en:
Main results (RQ1, RQ2). BaseRSI has the highest mean accuracy on all ten benchmarks and raises the ID and OOD averages of the base model by 11.7 and 6.1 points (Table 1 ).
Fine-tuning on the same development questions (SFT, GRPO) barely moves these averages, while the harness that the outer loop verifies lifts them, so the gain lies in what the harness learns rather than in fitting these questions.
Prompting, zoom-in, and harness evolution act through the request, whereas BaseRSI writes this gain into the weights, where it is largest on the benchmarks of the internalized entries (Table 2 ).
The acceptance test carries the gain to the held-out benchmarks: the finer view, which the base model proposes from its own failures, keeps its gain with any one benchmark left out, and testing the macro average alone lowers the OOD average (Figure 5 a).
The same loop, run from the original weights of Gemma-4-31B [ 61 ] , Qwen3.6-27B, and Qwen3.5-9B, internalizes entries that differ in part from those of Qwen3.8-27B and raises every benchmark score of each model (Figure 4 e, Appendix F ).
blocks.zh:
主要结果(RQ1,RQ2). BaseRSI在所有10个基准中的平均准确度最高,使基准模型的ID和OO平均值提高了11.7和6.1分(表1)。
同样的开发问题(SFT,GRPO)的微调几乎不会移动这些平均值,而外环验证的取用则能提升这些平均值,所以收益在于取用这些取用的方法所学到的东西,而不是适合这些问题.
BaseRSI将这一增益写入权重中, 在内部化条目的基准中, 其增幅最大(表2)。
接受测试将收益带入被搁置的基准:基准模型从其自身的失败中建议的更细视图,保留其收益,不计入任何一项基准,仅测试宏观平均值就降低了OOD平均值(图5a)。
同一回路,从Gemma-4-31B [61],Quen3.6-27B,和Quen3.5-9B的原始权重中运行,将部分不同于Quen3.8-27B的条目内部化,并提升了每个模型的每个基准分数(图4 e,附录F.).

blocks.en:
Recursive Harness Internalization (RQ3). The edited base model on original requests exceeds the same model with its harness in the request on all ten benchmarks and answers in one call (Figures 4 a and 4 h).
Inside the entry’s scope the two are level (Appendix E ), and the surplus comes from the questions that the router leaves out: there the teacher’s request has no procedure, while the student carries it in its weights behind a key that reads its own state, the advantage of a student trained with privileged information [ 62 , 36 ] .
Its edits compose without refitting because each is fitted on the base weights at its own site, and together they exceed the sum of their gains (Figure 4 b).
At the same view, the procedure edit gains on every benchmark (Table 2 ), while the up-scaled image alone in the request leaves the base model near the view edit (Figure 4 h).
Rounds on the student’s own responses make the edit hold on its own outputs, and three suffice (Figure 4 c): a one-shot edit fitted on the teacher’s responses loses part of its effect on its own responses (Figure 4 d), and the rounds add to it, while as many refits on the teacher’s add nothing (Table 2 ), so the gain comes from whose responses are replayed.
blocks.zh:
递归性能内化(RQ3). 最初请求的编辑基准模型超过同一模型,在所有10个基准的请求中加以利用,并在一个呼叫中作出答复(图4a和4h)。
在条目范围内,两者是等级(附录E),剩余部分来自路由器漏出的问题:教师的要求没有程序,而学生在读取自己状态的钥匙后面的权重,一个受过特权信息训练的学生的优势[62,36]。
它的编辑不重排,因为每个都安装在它自己的站点的基重上,它们加在一起超过了它们的收益之和(图4b).
同一观点认为,程序编辑每个基准的增益(表2),而请求中仅上调的图像则让基模型接近视图编辑(图4 h).
学生自己回应的回合会让编辑控制自己的产出,三(图4c)就足够了:在老师回应上一发一发的编辑会失去自己回应的部分效果(图4d),而回合会增加部分效果,而教师的复写会增加一分一分(表2),所以收益来自其回应被重播.

blocks.en:
ReGap (RQ4). Supervising every block with the gap carries the entry into the weights: in its scope the edited model matches the entry in the request (Figure 5 a, Appendix E ), and it follows the steps of the entry about as often as the teacher (Figure 4 g).
A unit step along the gap removes the divergence from the teacher, while gaps that are negated, shuffled, or taken from another block leave it (Figure 5 d), and the direct difference of the two runs’ states as the signal scores lower (Table 2 ).
Supervision at the output alone, distilling the same teacher, gains less than half of what ReGap gains, also when it trains only the neurons that BaseRSI writes (Figure 5 c, Appendix D ), since its signal travels back through every block from a few hundred responses.
On these neurons, gradient training toward the per-block gaps comes close to the closed-form solve, while the output loss restores nothing (Appendix E ), so the gain comes from the signal.
Null edits with the same neurons, key, and norms leave the ID average unchanged (Table 2 ), and the divergence falls only as all blocks’ gaps are added (Figure 5 e), so the fitted readouts of every block carry the gain.
blocks.zh:
ReGap (RQ4) (英语). 监督每个与空隙相通的块都携带入重:在其范围中被编辑的模型与请求中的条目相匹配(图5 a,附录 E),它跟随条目的步数大约与老师一样频繁(图4 g).
一个单位沿着差距走一步,消除了老师的分歧,而被否定、洗牌或从另一个街区取走的缺口则留下(图5 d),两个运行状态的直接差异作为信号分数较低(表2)。
仅监督产出,蒸馏同一老师,获得不到ReGap收益的一半,同样,它也只训练BaseRSI所写的神经元(图5c,附录D),因为它的信号从几百个回复中穿越出每个街区.
在这些神经元上,向每个区块间隙的梯度训练接近闭合形式解,而输出损失则还原了无所事事(Appendix E),所以收益来自信号.
以相同的神经元、密钥和规范进行 Null 编辑时,ID平均值保持不变(表2),差异只随着所有区块的缺口被添加而下降(图5 e),因此每个区块的配对读取会带来收益。

blocks.en:
ReKey (RQ5). Each measured quantity decides part of the edit, and every preset site, layer, or strength stays below the measured one (Figure 4 f).
The measured site sends the view entry to the patch embedding; in MLP neurons it loses most of its gain (Table 2 ).
The regression makes the edit a function of what each block reads: the mean gap alone adds little, and readouts along the principal directions of the fit supply the gain (Table 2 , Figure 5 a).
The measured strength offsets the shrinkage of the fit, and the line search picks the step with the least held-out divergence (Figure 5 f).
The fitted key decides where the edit acts: the edited model cites the procedure on 32% of in-scope responses and 0.5% of the others (Appendix E ), and a constant key lowers both averages (Table 2 ).
Internalization runs forward passes and one linear solve per block, with no backward pass or API call, in 45.5 GPU hours, the least of all methods (Figure 5 b); the procedure edit rewrites 0.23% of the weights and leaves the remaining weights bit-identical.
blocks.zh:
ReKey (RQ5) (英语). 每个被测量的数量决定部分编辑,每个被预设的站点,地层,或强度都停留在被测量的站点以下(图4 f.
被测量的站点将视图条目发送到补丁嵌入;在MLP神经元中,它损失了大部分增益(表2.
回归使编辑成为每个区块读取的函数:仅是平均差距就增加不多,并且按照适配供应的主要方向读取收益(表2,图5a)。
所测量出的力量抵消了相位的收缩,行搜索用最最小的被扣出相位来选择步骤(图5 f).
装配的密钥决定编辑行为地点:编辑过的模型引用了32%的镜内反应和0.5%的其他反应(附录E)的程序,一个恒定密钥都低于平均值(表2)。
内部化先行通过并每块一个线性解析,没有后行通过或API调用,在45.5 GPU小时,是所有方法中最小的(图5b);该程序会重写0.23%的权重并留下所剩的权重比特-等同.

blocks.en: BaseRSI unifies harness evolution, weight editing, and internalization in one recursive loop with ReGap and ReKey, and the base model alone improves on every benchmark.

blocks.en:
An entry holds a scope in words, or the scope of every request, and an action: a procedure text added to the prompt, request settings, or an operation on the views of the image.
The base model with its original weights is the proposer: it reads its own responses on the fitting questions and writes candidate entries (Table 3 ). The reference answers of the development questions mark which of these responses fail and score the acceptance test.
The base model is also the router: asked, without thinking and on the original view of the image, whether a request falls inside the scope of an entry, it answers yes or no, which gives κ c ​ ( q ) \kappa_{c}(q) .
The system kept between generations holds a general layer of entries and a layer of entries accepted for single ID benchmarks.
In the reported run the loop runs eight generations and its proposer writes 269 candidates; the finer view, accepted in generation 1, and the counting procedure, accepted in generation 2, are internalized in this order, the procedure edit on top of the view edit.

blocks.en:
The five ID benchmarks supply 640 development questions, split by image into 270 fitting and 370 validation questions (54 and 74 per benchmark), and an ID test of 640 questions on disjoint images.
The procedure edit is fitted on the 57 fitting questions that the router sends to the counting entry, and its key is fitted against 75 that it does not.
The five OOD benchmarks supply 640 test questions and are held out from the proposer, the acceptance test, and every fit.
Each test set has 128 questions, and a test score is the accuracy on them, averaged over three runs.
The regression uses the fitting questions alone. A held-out fold of them, drawn by a hash of the question identifier, selects the ridge weight of each block, and the step and the restoration are measured on responses to further fitting questions held out from the regression. The validation questions serve the acceptance test alone. Every setting in Table 4 is chosen on the development questions. The view edit sets the patch size to 8 and, in the preprocessing configuration stored with the weights, 524,288 to 1,048,576 pixels per image, that is 2,048 to 4,096 image tokens of 2 × \times 2 patches; the request carries no image setting. The development splits are released together with the code.

blocks.en: Accuracy is scored by one rule-based grader shared by all methods: it reads the final answer of a response, matches option letters, yes or no, and normalized short text, and matches numbers exactly. The standard deviation in Table 1 is the sample standard deviation of the accuracy over the three runs of a method. Restoration is the fraction of the divergence from the teacher that an edit removes on a held-out response, averaged over the responses of a set (defined in Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 准确性由所有方法共同使用的一个基于规则的分级器来评分:它读取一个响应的最终答案,匹配选项字母,是或否,以及规范化的短文本,准确匹配数字. 表1中的标准偏差是某方法三跑中精度的样本标准偏差. 恢复是编辑在被搁置的响应上消除的与老师的分歧的一小部分,平均于一组响应(在附录C中定义).

blocks.en:
All methods but the closed-source models use the same base model, reasoning effort, token budget, evaluator, and test questions.
Self-consistency takes the majority of five responses of the base model, and the 4-shot baseline adds four examples to the request.
SFT and GRPO train on the development questions until convergence, which gives each its full training budget: SFT with a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , cosine decay, 10% warm-up, and 32 samples per update; GRPO with a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} after 20 warm-up updates and, in each round, 8 sampled responses to each of 64 questions and 8 updates of 64 responses. LBS-27B is a released checkpoint fine-tuned from the same base model and answers with its own crop loop. PixelProof is the LoRA adapter released by its authors (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 ), merged into the same base model with no further training.
The closed-source models are Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna, each at its default reasoning effort. Harness kept in the request (Table 2 , Figure 4 a) is the base model with the finer view and the counting procedure kept in the request and no weight edit applied. Up-scaled image in request (Figure 4 h) is the base model with the image enlarged in the request, which gives it the finer view while all of its weights stay unchanged; on the OOD benchmarks it reaches 67.2, against 68.8 for the view edit alone and 70.7 for BaseRSI.

除闭源模型外,所有方法都使用相同的基模型,推理努力,符号预算,评估,测试问题.
自相容取了基础模型的5个响应的大多数,而4发基线为请求增加了4个实例.
SFT和GRPO就发展问题进行训练,直到汇合,这给每个培训预算提供了全部预算:SFT的学习率为10 - 6 10 - 6 },余弦衰变,10%热能,每次更新32个样本;GRPO的不断学习率为2 × 10 - 6 2\times 10 - 6 },经过20个热能更新后,每轮对64个问题中的每个问题进行了8个抽样答复,对64个答复进行了8个更新。 LBS-27B是一个从同一种基模型中解开的检查点并用自有的收成回路进行微调并解答. PixelProof是其作者所发布的LORA适配器(排名16,α=32\alpha=32),被合并为同一种基模型而不再接受再培训.
闭源模型有克洛德·海库·5.5和GPT-6·卢纳等,各自在其默认推理努力中. 请求中保持的优点(表2,图4a)是基准模型,其视图更细,请求中保留了计数程序,没有应用重量编辑. 请求中提升的图像(图4 h)是扩展了请求中图像的基模型,在它的所有权重保持不变的情况下,其更细小的视图;在OOD基准上,仅编辑视图就达到67.2,而BaseRSI则达到68.8.

blocks.en: On the 102 in-scope validation questions the edited model alone answers 89.9% right, against 90.2% for the teacher and 70.9% for the base model, and it gives the teacher’s final answer on 89.9% of them (Table 7 ). On the 266 test questions that the router sends to the entry, it answers 81.2% right, against 80.2% for the teacher and 65.5% for the base model. A judge, the base model reading the steps of the entry and one response, decides whether the response carries the steps out; its wording was fixed on a calibration set of 40 responses and agrees with human labels on 18 of 20 unseen ones. On these 266 questions it finds the steps followed in 65.7% of the responses of the edited model, against 70.1% for the teacher, 59.4% for the view edit alone, and 54.5% for the base model.

blocks.en: An edit removes more of the divergence on the responses it is fitted on than on the responses it generates: the round-1 edit, fitted on responses under the entry, removes 0.652 on teacher responses and 0.504 on its own (Table 8 ). The rounds on the student’s own responses add their gain on held-out benchmarks, 70.7 against 68.3 for the same number of refits on teacher responses (Table 2 ).

Three controls hold the edit at 4,160 neurons and change one choice each. Distilled from the same teacher at the output, the neurons that BaseRSI writes reach 69.8 ID and 69.1 OOD, against 72.1 and 70.7 for BaseRSI (Appendix D ).
Trained by gradient, they restore 0.560 ± \pm 0.037 with the per-block gaps as targets and − - 0.052 ± \pm 0.159 with the output loss alone; the closed-form solve restores 0.593 on the same 28 held-out responses. Written as 260 neurons in each of the 16 full-attention blocks, the edit answers 89.3 ID and 87.9 OOD test questions of 128 right, against 92.3 and 90.5 over all 64 blocks. On 306 further responses that entered no choice of a setting, the exported edit restores 0.562 ± \pm 0.026.

Table 18 runs the loop of BaseRSI on three other vision-language models and tests each of them on the same ten benchmarks over three runs. The loop starts from the original weights of each model, and the entries that it accepts and internalizes differ in part from those of Qwen3.8-27B.

The gain is largest on BabyVision for the two Qwen models (16.1 and 11.0 points) and on VLMs Are Biased for Gemma-4-31B (20.6 points), the two benchmarks on which it is also the largest on Qwen3.8-27B (Table 1 ).

在Baby Vision对两个Quen模型(16.1分和11.0分)和VLMs Are Biased对Gemma-4-31B(20.6分)的收益最大,这两个基准在Quen3.8-27B上也是最大的(表1)。

blocks.en:
Table 19 gives the test accuracy on each benchmark for the variants of Table 2 and Figure 5 a, together with the sweeps over the rank and the step.
The edits act on different benchmarks: without the view edit BabyVision falls most, from 60.7 to 39.1, and without the procedure edit VLMs Are Biased falls most, from 91.1 to 78.4, while BabyVision stays at 58.9.
Most variants of the procedure edit therefore differ on VLMs Are Biased, where the counting entry applies: the last-block edit lowers it to 78.9 and the mean gap alone to 79.7, while BabyVision moves by less than 1.5 points.
Writing the most active neurons lowers the benchmarks outside the scope of the entry the most (BabyVision 49.7, SpatialViz 52.6), since it overwrites neurons that the base model uses on every question, and writing the view entry into MLP neurons loses the gain on BabyVision (38.3 against 60.7).
blocks.zh:
表19列出了表2和图5a的变式的每个基准的测试准确性,以及军衔和职级的扫码。
编辑以不同的基准进行:没有视图编辑 Baby Vision 降得最多,从60.7降至39.1;没有程序编辑 VLM Are Biased 降得最多,从91.1降至78.4;而 Baby Vision 降得最多,从58.9。
因此,程序编辑的多数变体在VLMs Are Biased上不同,其中计数条目适用:最后一个块的编辑将它降低到78.9,而平均差距仅是79.7,而Baby Vision移动不到1.5分.
写出最活性的神经元最能降低进入范围以外的基准(Baby Vision 49.7, SpaceViz 52.6),因为它覆盖了基准模型在每个问题上使用的神经元,而将视图条目写入MLP神经元则会失去"婴儿视觉"上的收益(38.3对60.7).

Restoration measures how much of the teacher’s next-token distribution an edit reproduces on held-out responses, the validation counts how many answers it changes, and the test scores whether the change carries to new questions.
In Table 20 , each added round raises the restoration (0.583, 0.590, 0.593) and the in-scope gain ( + + 16.3, + + 17.6, + + 19.0).
Further rounds (Table 21 ) change the restoration by at most 0.002 each and the ID accuracy by at most 0.7 correct answers.
Fitting on base-model responses alone restores 0.515, with 90.3 and 86.9 on the tests against 92.3 and 90.5.

blocks.en:
In Table 22 , an edit of a subset of blocks restores little unless it contains the full-attention blocks of the second half: the last block alone restores 0.005, the first 32 blocks 0.055, the 48 linear-attention blocks 0.093, and the last 16 blocks 0.304, while the 16 full-attention blocks restore 0.580.
Even this subset gains less than all 64 blocks, in scope ( + + 14.7 against + + 19.0) and on the OOD tests (85.9 against 90.5 correct); Appendix E repeats the comparison with all 4,160 neurons.
The 48 linear-attention blocks hold three times the neurons of the 16 full-attention blocks and restore 0.093 against 0.580, and ranks 96 and 128 add neurons without raising the restoration (Table 12 ), so the placement of an edit, not its size, decides what it restores.
The target matters as much as the site: the difference of the last-block states restores 0.271.
Adding 64 reasoning positions to the template tail restores 0.575, close to the 0.593 of BaseRSI, and 16 or 64 replayed responses per round restore 0.541 and 0.578.

The removals sum to 1.358, more than the 0.997 that all gaps remove together, since the divergence is not additive over blocks, and no subset in Table 22 reaches the restoration of all 64.

Writing the pairs into 65 random neurons per block restores 0.474, and writing them into the 65 most active neurons raises the divergence ( − - 2.119) and keeps only + + 1.0 out of scope, since those neurons carry what the base model computes on every request.

Figure 7 sets the cost of improving the base model (Table 6 ) beside the accuracy that each method reaches (Table 1 ).
BaseRSI is the cheapest and the most accurate: 45.5 GPU hours for 72.1 ID and 70.7 OOD, against 51.4 hours and 34.0 M API input tokens for Meta-Harness, the next cheapest, which reaches 63.1 and 67.7.
More compute does not buy accuracy among the other methods: GEPA spends 186.6 hours for 62.5 ID and SFT 230.9 for 60.9, and SFT and GRPO stay within 0.8 points of the base model in distribution.

blocks.en:
We take the cases from the 1,280 test questions.
On 38 of them the base model is wrong in all three runs with seeds 0 to 2 and BaseRSI right in all three, against 6 questions the other way, a split that sampling noise alone would make even; among these we keep the ones that the other methods on the same base model mostly miss, and add questions on which the base model is right in at most two of ten runs.
Some of these answers turn on the finer view and others on the procedure; we show both kinds, eight questions from four benchmarks, two of them held out (Figures 8 to 16 ; Table 25 gathers their runs by setting).
The two edits repair different failures: the view edit lets the model see what the question asks about, and the procedure edit, fitted by ReGap and written by ReKey, makes it count what it sees in place of the value it expects.
On six questions the answer turns on the finer view, with the view edit alone right in at least four of five runs; on the rings it turns on the procedure, with the procedure edit alone right in 2 of 3 runs and the view edit alone in none; on the stripes both edits contribute.
Together the edits are right more often than either alone, in 55 of 56 runs against 31 of 40 for the view edit and 6 of 24 for the procedure edit, as on the benchmarks (Figure 4 b).
The view edit is also right more often than the up-scaled image in the request, in 31 against 25 of 40 runs: as often on four questions and more often on the other four.
The share of right runs rises with the step of the procedure edit, from 19 and 18 of 24 at steps 0.5 and 1.0 to 23 of 24 at step 1.5 and 55 of 56 at the step 1.8 that the line search of ReKey selects; the procedure edits of round 1 and of rounds 1 and 2 are right in 22 of 24 runs each.
The two held-out questions follow the same pattern, the view edit alone right in four and five of five runs and BaseRSI in all seven.
The base model is right in 5 of 80 runs, the other methods in 28 of 248, at most 8 of their 31 on one question, and the four closed-source models in 30 of 168 over seven effort levels, at most 9 of their 21.
Appendix E and Table 2 give the controls: shuffled gaps or gaps of another block leave the divergence, null edits leave the ID average unchanged, and no preset site or strength reaches the measured one.

blocks.en:
One observation recurs across the counting questions.
With the procedure edit, the thinking of the model often cites an instruction to trust direct observation rather than the typical value, although the request carries no such text: ReGap and ReKey have written the entry into the weights, and the model recalls it as if it were part of the request.
Over all replies to 21 candidate questions, a fixed pattern finds such a citation in 46 of the 147 replies of BaseRSI, in 0, 4, 16, and 21 of 63 replies at steps 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, and 2.0, and in none of the 42 replies of the base model, the 63 of the view edit, or the 109 of chain-of-thought, 4-shot, and ZoomEye prompting.
The citation grows with the step and is absent without the edit, so it comes from the edit, and it appears on counting questions only, never on the chart or odd-one-out questions, matching the scope that the key carries.
blocks.zh:
一种观察在计数问题中反复出现。
随着程序的编辑,模型的思考经常引用一个指令来信任直接观察而不是典型的值,尽管请求没有包含这样的文本:ReGap和ReKey已经将条目写入了权重中,模型回忆起来就像它是请求的一部分.
在对21个候选问题的所有答复中,一种固定模式在BaseRSI的147个答复中的46个,在0.5、1.0、1.5和2.0步骤的63个答复中的0、4、16和21个,以及在基准模式的42个答复中,没有一个是63个编辑,或109个思维链、4发和ZoomEye提示。
引文会随步而增长而去而无编辑,因此出自编辑而来,仅以数出问题而出,从不出现在图表上或奇一出题上,与密钥所携带的范围相匹配.
